dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Hmm, come to think of it, I've heard that some people saw some ore resembling purplish crystals nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: That said, I'm just a businessperson, and I'm not in the mining business either. And it's not like I can leave my store so easily, anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: I'd say that they saw it around... here. There, it should be marked on your map now. If you think it'll be of any use to you, feel free to take a look.
